notes.title: Floridale Man: The Joy of Development Updates, Issue 3
notes.content:
The Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos demo is OUT NOW!

That's right, you can finally experience Floridale for yourself! We've released a special demo for this week only as a part of Steam Next Fest (and to celebrate the final days of our Kickstarter, which you should totally back if you haven't yet). This demo features the beach, one of the main areas of the game.

Play it now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925460/Floridale_Man_The_Joy_of_Chaos/

See the sights! Take in some rays! Figure out why Poseidon's all bummed out! Summon an eldritch being! Or even just set some stuff on fire! The world is your oyster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037479/766a177571ac24296788d3a9bc3d2d4bc64fff68.gif

We're so excited to hear what you folks think of the demo. Thanks in advance for giving it a spin! And thank you once again, and a million times over, for your continued support.

notes.title: Floridale Man: The Joy of Development Updates, Issue 2
notes.content:
Hi folks! We've got a lot to fill you in on, so let's get right into it.

We launched our Kickstarter!

If you didn't watch the showcase, we just launched the Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos Kickstarter campaign with the help of our friends over at Six One Indie! Watch the new gameplay trailer that went with the announcement:

[previewyoutube=TceOZ82h_VM;full][/previewyoutube]
Please back our campaign and help us spread the word! We'll even reveal some special behind-the-scenes content if y'all make enough noise. 👀 Make sure to tag your fan art with the #FloridaleManArt hashtag. We love gushing over the stuff you send us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037479/7a2e00fc2c8a87076d0405bb02240b1f101bad6e.png

Every bit of support helps us make this game even better and ensures we can keep making weird and meaningful stuff in the future.

Big thanks to Six One Indie for featuring us!

We're also so excited to have been a part of Six One Indie's Fall showcase this year. They've been incredibly supportive of us these past few months. Real rad group of people I must say. Check out all the indies featured in the Six One Indie Showcase Steam event when you get the chance!

Six One Indie even did an exclusive interview with our CEO, Trento. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=p9KHNsABLN8;full][/previewyoutube]
As always, thank you!

Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU from the bottom of our hearts for all your love and support. It's been busy for us the past couple of months between the showcase, our Kickstarter, and Anime NYC. Your support really does mean the world to us, and we can't wait to show you what's in store for us next.

If you haven't already, please wishlist our game! Wishlists help scrappy teams like ours stand out on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925460/Floridale_Man_The_Joy_of_Chaos/

notes.title: Floridale Man: The Joy of Development Updates, Issue 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It’s been a bit. We’ve got some UPDATES for y’all!

First up: We’re going to Anime NYC next week, August 23-25! We’ll be there with our friends at Play NYC exhibiting in the Gaming Hall. It’s our first time showing Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos off in public, and we’re hyped. Please stop by and say hi if you’ll be in town! We’ll update you with the exact location of our booth on the floor as soon as we’re able. You can learn more on the Anime NYC website.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037479/13a1063185823d9653c0295d9edfe0088844bb2b.png
Shout out to my mom back home for holding onto all our booth stuff for us.

Second: We’re launching a Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos Kickstarter! Please pre-save our campaign when you get the chance. You’ll be notified when the Kickstarter officially launches, and your early support would mean so much to us.

As far as dev goes, we’re still hard at work! Things feel like they’re really starting to come together over here. We’re updating the UI, adding new character models to the game, designing levels, and setting every NPC on fire in playtests. (Ok, at least that’s what I do in playtests.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037479/0fc80b3efaca828a866c20b1cd65bee4069ac034.gif

That’s all we’ve got for now. Thanks again for your support as we’ve been working hard to make the game happen. We’ll have some more news for you in the coming weeks, but in the meantime, please wishlist our game if you haven’t yet! It would mean so much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925460/Floridale_Man_The_Joy_of_Chaos/
